snippet.title: Pure Badminton | Demo announcement
snippet.description:
The demo is out! You can play it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4013610/Pure_Badminton_Demo/

Pure Badminton is the most realistic Badminton simulation game.
Experience the sensations of badminton, in a fast, technical and strategical game.

https://www.instagram.com/pure.badminton/
